abilities.name: Wild Mutation
abilities.text: If the active unit is ON CREEP, the unit gains BUFF Speed (1) and its first used Weapon gains PRECISION (1).

abilities.name: Zerg Creep
abilities.text: During Army Building, you must select exactly one Creep Card and add it to your Army List, paying its listed cost (if any).

abilities.name: Omega Network
abilities.text: If there is no Friendly Omega Worm on the battlefield, set a Friendly Omega Worm Unit anywhere on GROUND LEVEL of the battlefield, more than 10″ away from any Enemy model. This Round, the Omega Worm is not eligible to use its Special Abilities (excluding Structure).
